_: What a part's own pixels are (clean.py; held by tools/test/portrait.test.ts). Per slot: r the core's half width (an opening by a (2r+1) square; 0: no core, a part of dots and fine strokes), reach how far the core grows back along the layer's own pixels (reachOn: on the body, where its own lines lie), piece the smallest core piece, band the rows it may lie in ([unit, f]: h head heights below the head's top, the neck at 1; t a fraction of the figure, the soles at 1), head: hung from the head (a piece away from the head is kept only off the body; a solid piece mostly on the eyes is an eye, and nothing thin is kept over them). parts: a part's own numbers over its slot's; eyes false: never over the eyes the body's faces draw. speck, faint: a component smaller than speck pixels, or never more than faint coverage, is speckle. ground: the bases' flat ground; a layer's pixels of it (within groundTol, keeping their paint) in pieces of groundPiece or on its outer edge are the ground taken in — a part's only off its body inset by groundInset pixels, or on the eyes (well inside the body, a highlight it drew) — except in the slots of groundKept (the eyes' whites, a lens's glint). holes: in those slots' layers, what is not fully covered and the layer's coverage encloses, in pieces of at most max pixels, is a pinhole, filled from the nearest covered pixel; a piece keeping its paint of at most speck pixels, wholly inside the repainted hair and lighter than ink (luminance over ink), takes the hair's zone.
